scope: Original writing patterns, editorial angles, inferred viewer needs, and sampled visual-word relationships across the complete source timelines.

preserve.voiceAndSound: Approved Nhật Phong preset and sound approach

sourceStructureCaveat: Observed references vary: opening disclaimer in Vĩnh Hưng/TCG; Châu Âu opens with a scope caveat; Huấn has an investigation caveat later. Do not attribute the user-required four-part structure uniformly to all sources.
editingLessons: Choose the subject and relationship before choosing effects.
Use subject-related source media for specific cases and concise diagrams for causal relations.
Reveal one useful relation at a time; do not turn every clause into a dashboard.
Change layouts when narrative function changes, not on an arbitrary image timer.
Return to the opening question with a supported answer before CTA.
Treat source labels, ASR, numbers and illustrations as fallible; inspect mismatches.
limits: Complete transcript and sampled-frame review is not continuous audiovisual playback or auditory approval.
Audience/retention interpretations are hypotheses; no private channel analytics were available.
Source claims were studied as rhetoric, not independently fact-verified.
Reference download does not authorize asset republication.
Saving this profile updates reusable project knowledge, not model weights.
This research does not authorize a new video or visual redesign.
